name: Integrated WTI Forecast

delivery_scope.parameter_policy: Frozen as of September 30; only published daily inputs update.
delivery_scope.change: All v5 point forecasts and h1/h20/h60 distributions retained. Only h5 tail recalibration adopted.
delivery_scope.selection_policy: Previously observed October is retrospective evaluation only, never tuning or promotion selection. All models and calibration are frozen using September 30 available information.

point_meaning: Median of the final coherent predictive distribution.

risk_safety.reason: Raw coverage-constrained selection still undercovered short horizons after a regime change and doubled h60 width.
risk_safety.policy: Take an outward quantile envelope with the causally issued incumbent shape at the new center. Interpolate back toward the incumbent if the 90% price interval exceeds 1.5 times incumbent width.
risk_safety.cap_selection: Fixed research safeguard, not selected using October or a grid of caps.
risk_safety.promotion_thresholds: Unchanged original v5 thresholds; all new results remain adaptive historical development.

module_roles.m1: Actual VECM expert and inherited residual features; its influence is checked by perturbing the actual input.
module_roles.m2: Actual monthly STL expert, inherited residual features and calendar state variables.
module_roles.lstm: Actual three-seed LSTM expert and inherited residual model features.
module_roles.ml_point: Original point ML and long-history residual experts; learned state gates and conditional error models assess reliability.
module_roles.ml_distribution: ML shape/scale candidates, released-error tail calibration and empirical coverage constraints; guarded 63-quantile distribution.
module_roles.incumbent: Frozen v4 remains the anchor; new meta-policy updates have a fixed 50% maximum contribution.

inherited_v5.interpretation: This adds nested time selection for the new layer. Inherited base specifications and repeated historical research remain conditional; source vintages and publication assumptions are unchanged.

source_audit.availability: Session quote + 2 US federal business days; never same-day OHLCV.
source_audit.limitation: Current-vintage unadjusted Close; verified overlap through EIA historical endpoint, not a complete point-in-time vendor archive.

limitations: Inherited base specifications and repeated historical research remain conditional; unchanged vintage and publication assumptions. No theoretical coverage guarantee for dependent observations.
Previously observed October is retrospective evaluation only, never tuning or promotion selection. All models and calibration are frozen using September 30 available information.
No 1-day or 5-day point improvement was validated. The proposed corrections worsened RMSE by 32.6%/51.5% and were rejected.
New interval evidence compares the same June–September origins (76/72 at h1/h5), not the earlier March–September totals.
The h5 interval is 35% wider; historical coverage remains below 90%. October has only 13 h5 targets.
One narrower cap was introduced after historical inspection; original thresholds and unsuccessful experiments are preserved.
No realized October outcomes exist for h20/h60. Their forecasts and intervals are unchanged.
